name: Corner attendant
design: Small agile adult female with bright rust speckled hide, low elongated skull, four fine mandibles, short black dreadlocks tied high with long loose side strands. Honey-ochre sleeveless tunic, one dark folded shoulder shawl, broad cloth sash, narrow side satchel and calf wraps. Holds neatly folded charcoal officiating cloth and two small sealed token boxes under left arm, right hand open. No medical symbols.
